During development, test_tscheck_audit_events.py's scope-forced-to-mine assertion intermittently failed under the mandated -n 2 --dist loadscope xdist config because a concurrently-running module (admin_role_management) briefly promotes the shared analyst user to admin. Diagnosed as a cross-module test race (not an app bug) via a serial (-n 0) rerun that passed 3/3, then fixed by adding a cross-process file lock shared between the two modules' critical sections; the default addopts suite then passed 3/3 consecutive runs.

All admin.* mutations performed during testing (domain policy, analyst role, mobile session revoke) were restored: access policy is open_access=true with empty allowed_domains, test-analyst-2001 role is 'analyst', and sess_test_admin_mobile was re-seeded via Mongo upsert exactly as instructed.
